hero.title: About TEDxAlKawmia
hero.p1: For years, local thinkers and creators had to travel to capital metropolises to be heard. TEDxAlKawmia was founded to shatter that geographic centralization.
hero.p2: Operated under official license from TED, we build an architectural stage where local researchers, creators, and pioneers present ideas that challenge comfortable assumptions.

theme.title: The Unlimited Doors
theme.subtitle: Every idea is an entrance. Every connection is an opening. Three threshold movements define our program.

steps.title: THE SPARK
steps.desc: Curiosity ignited by an unasked question. The sudden moment of intellectual rupture in the darkness.

steps.title: THE KEY
steps.desc: Rigorous curation, relentless craft, and personal agency forged within our year-round training corridors.

steps.title: THE DOOR
steps.desc: Stepping onto the red dot. The threshold crossed to transform individual perspective into collective movement.

principles.imageDesc: A community bound by truth, curiosity, and relentless belief in youth leadership.
principles.title: Core Principles
principles.subtitle: The non-negotiable standards that govern how we curate ideas, train leaders, and build our community.

items.title: Idea-Driven Focus
items.desc: We exist to discover, nurture, and elevate ideas that challenge the status quo and spark meaningful global transformation.

items.title: Youth Catalyst
items.desc: Empowering young minds with the platform, tools, and mentorship required to turn bold vision into real-world action.

items.title: Continuous Incubation
items.desc: We are a year-round empowerment academy. The event is merely the summit; the true work happens in our youth training corridors.

items.title: Radical Authenticity
items.desc: No rehearsed corporate speak. We coach speakers to strip away fluff and present their truths with raw, unpolished clarity.

tedInfo.title: What is TED & TEDx?
tedInfo.subtitle: Understanding the covenant between global guidance and independent grassroots execution.
tedInfo.tedDesc: TED is a nonprofit organization devoted to Ideas Worth Spreading, often in the form of short talks given by leading thinkers and doers. Many of these talks are given at TED's annual conference in Vancouver and made available, free, at TED.com.
tedInfo.tedxDesc: In the spirit of ideas worth spreading, TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. At a TEDx event, TED Talks video and live speakers combine to spark deep discussion and connection.
tedInfo.licenseDesc: TEDxAlKawmia is operated under an official license from TED Conferences LLC. This independent TEDx event is operated under license from TED. All speakers perform independently, and opinions expressed on stage are strictly their own.

timeline.title: The Story of TEDxAlKawmia
timeline.subtitle: How an ambitious campus idea transformed into an influential regional intellectual movement.

items.title: The Inception & First License
items.desc: Secured the official TED license for AlKawmia. A founding committee of 18 motivated students assembled to build the foundational constitution, setting our sights on hosting the premier local youth symposium.

items.title: Edition I: "Breaking the Mold"
items.desc: Held our inaugural conference at the Main Auditorium with 450 attendees and 8 speakers covering sustainable energy, social entrepreneurship, and Arabic computational linguistics.

items.title: Edition II: "Uncharted Horizons"
items.desc: Scaled to over 900 delegates, introducing interactive design workshops, creative art exhibits, and publishing our talk recordings which gained over 350,000 views globally.

items.title: Edition III: "Spark Unlimited Doors"
items.desc: Launching our integrated Member Portal, mobile check-ins, year-round micro-salons, and prepping our biggest mainstage production with 1,500+ attendees anticipated.
